Select this option to start the gameplay mode selection process.
Your character will start on a small island with several altars. Using one of the altars will set your gameplay mode and start your journey.

Available gameplay modes include:
- Hardcore: death is permanent!
- Hardcore PK: death is permanent and other Hardcore PKs can kill you!
- Solo Self-Found: Can only use items found by the character.

More details on each mode can be found by examing the appropriate altar.
